meta.title: A vendor's first technical submission is time-stamped, replaces its drafts and adds it to the participants
gaps: No operation can submit a vendor's technical draft.
the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup does not provide two technical drafts for the same alternative, so replacement of the other draft cannot be checked.
No read operation exposes technical response submission time, active/inactive draft status, or the vendor's pending tasks.
No operation or read-back can verify that later revisions retain the first submission time.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited to both rounds; both open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor starts a technical response on the RFP round.
As the invited QA vendor, read the technical round and check that Data check: “participants” contains {{vendorUuid}}.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “participants” contains {{vendorUuid}}.
